parameters.confirmed: 3/4-inch crown; flat backs; 0.6 mm maple on both panel faces (supersedes the R7 veneer parameter); original R7 frame dimensions.
parameters.assumptions: 6.10 mm finished panel tongue envelope retained from R7. Glue-line thickness is zero in CAD. Actual veneer thickness, bending/pressing, core material and edge/lap construction must be resolved on a sample.
parameters.orientation: All drawings: left/right as seen from cabinet front; curved/front face up, flat back down. Trace the opposite blank end with the template flipped, keeping the same physical inner/outer edges.

parts.label: RAIL L
parts.note: Left half, viewed from above with the door front at the top of the drawing. Butt at the centerline; align both straight back edges. Fits either rail.

parts.label: RAIL R
parts.note: Right half. Same arc for top and bottom rails; this is the thickness profile, not their asymmetric elevation outline.

parts.label: STILE L
parts.note: Outer door edge at left; inner/grooved edge at right. Trace rectangular blank ends before cutting the shaped rail joints.

parts.label: STILE R
parts.note: Inner/grooved edge at left; outer door edge at right. Trace rectangular blank ends before cutting the shaped rail joints.

parts.label: PANEL L CORE
